transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you here today?

I guess… I’m here because people keep acting like I’m making something out of nothing. For months there’ve been these little things with money, and people’s attitudes, like at church or work, and I know my husband’s family is behind it. They’re messing with our name, quietly. Even when someone pulls up records and says it doesn’t show that, it all connects back to them somehow.
Can you tell me more about how you know your husband’s family is behind these things? Have you noticed any specific actions or evidence that confirms this for you?

It’s not like they leave a note saying they did it. It’s just… the timing, and the way things keep happening. Little billing mistakes come up, or someone at church suddenly treats me different, like they’ve heard something. Then people say the records don’t show anything, but that doesn’t mean it isn’t connected. I know my husband’s family has been doing things quietly, messing with our money and our name.
Have you ever seen or heard things that others don't, like voices or images that aren't really there?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t seen things like that, or heard voices. It’s more just what’s happening around me.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that other people don’t share, that you know are true even though they don’t believe you or think you’re mistaken?

Yes. I mean… that’s kind of why I’m here. People don’t believe me, but I know my husband’s family has been quietly causing problems with our money and our name. Little billing things come up, people at church start acting strange toward me… and even when someone says the records don’t show it, I know it ties back to them somehow.
Even though people have checked the records and found no proof, do you still believe, without any doubt, that your husband's family is behind these problems?

Yes. I know people say there’s no proof in the records, but… I don’t need it written down to know what’s going on. For months these little things keep happening—with money, billing, people acting different toward me—and it all comes back to my husband’s family. They’re just careful about it.
Even though there’s no proof in the records and others don’t share your belief, does it feel absolutely certain to you, like it can't be questioned?

Yes… it feels certain to me. I know other people don’t see it, and the records don’t show it, but these things keep happening — the billing errors, people acting different — and I know it comes back to his family. They’re just quiet about it.
Even if someone were to show you clear proof that your husband's family isn't involved, would you still believe they are the ones causing these problems?

I mean… if they showed me something, I’d look at it. But records don’t always show what people are doing quietly. These things have been happening for months — money issues, little billing mistakes, people acting strange — and I still feel like it ties back to his family.
Even if someone were to show you clear proof that your husband's family isn't involved, would you still believe they are the ones causing these problems?

I… yes, I think I still would. Papers can say one thing, but they don’t show everything people do quietly. For months it’s been little money things, billing errors, people acting different toward me… and I know it connects back to his family.
Even if you were shown clear evidence that no one is deliberately acting against you, would you still believe that your husband’s family is secretly causing these problems?

Yes… I think I would. I know people can show records, but records don’t show everything. For months it’s been little billing mistakes, money problems, people acting strange toward me… and I can’t shake that it all ties back to his family.

Even if you were shown clear and convincing evidence that no one is doing anything against you, would you still believe, deep down, that your husband’s family is secretly responsible for these problems?

Yes… deep down, yes. I know what papers can say, but it’s been going on for months — the little billing errors, money things, people at church acting different. It all still feels like it goes back to his family, even if nobody wants to see it.
Can you think of any kind of proof or situation that would convince you that your husband’s family is not involved in these problems?

I don’t really know what proof would be enough. People can pull up records or say it’s just mistakes, but those little billing errors and the way people act toward me… it keeps happening. So I’d still feel like it ties back to his family somehow.
